---
title: "Why this site"
description: "What to expect here: research pages that change slowly, and a blog of short notes that change often."
date: 2026-11-08
categories: [meta]
---

This site has two halves.

The first is the set of pages you reach from the top bar — [research](../../../research.qmd),
[publications](../../../publications.qmd), [software](../../../software.qmd). They describe
what I work on and change slowly, when a paper is accepted or a program gains a feature.

The second is this blog. It is for the things that do not fit in a paper but are worth
writing down once, carefully: a derivation that every textbook skips a step of, a
numerical detail that cost an afternoon, a comparison between two ways of doing the same
computation. The model is the kind of post Sébastien Brisard writes on
[his blog](https://sbrisard.github.io): short, self-contained, with the equations
and the code in plain sight.

Posts are written in [Quarto](https://quarto.org), so mathematics renders with KaTeX
and code blocks can be executed when the page is built. Everything is in the
[repository](https://github.com/augustobopsinborges/aborges.github.io); corrections are
welcome as issues or pull requests.
